verdict_line: $6.82B of gross revenue on a 20.1% net margin, run by 9,000 people — the most people-intensive economics on the roster, in the one model AI reshapes fastest. C.H. Robinson has already proved what is possible.

thesis.text: The economics are now visible. Gross revenue of $6.82 billion in 2024 at a net revenue margin of 20.1%, giving net revenue of approximately $1.37 billion — the third-largest freight broker by revenue.

It is carried by headcount. Approximately 9,000 employees across 56 offices and a network of over 130,000 carriers. Dedicated account teams and 24/7 service are the differentiator — and the cost structure most exposed to automation.

Revenue is highly cyclical: $4.1 billion (2020), $7.8 billion (2021), $8.8 billion (2022), $6.7 billion (2023), $6.82 billion (2024). A business that can swing 25% in a year cannot carry fixed people cost through a trough.
The peer benchmark is brutal and public. C.H. Robinson has cut headcount 28.7% since mid-2023 while growing volume, on 60%+ productivity gains. That is the number a TQL executive has to answer.

exhibits.title: Revenue trajectory and margin
exhibits.headline: $6.82 billion gross and $1.37 billion net in 2024 — after a 24% peak-to-trough swing.
exhibits.body_html:
TQL is privately held and does not file financial statements. Per the Transport Topics 2025 freight-brokerage rankings, 2024 gross revenue was $6.82 billion with a net revenue margin of 20.1%, equating to roughly $1.37 billion of net revenue, across approximately 9,000 employees, 56 offices and 130,000+ carriers. Founded 1997 by Ken Oaks, who remains CEO, President Kerry Byrne. Cincinnati's largest private company. Because it is private, profitability is not disclosed.

TQL's TRAX platform has undergone an AI-driven overhaul, with the company emphasising machine learning for capacity prediction and spot pricing, and asset-light capital expenditure of roughly 1.2% of revenue redirected toward technology and sales.
exhibits.sowhat: At 20.1% net margin across $6.82 billion of gross revenue, one point of productivity is worth real money — and they are already building AI internally. The opening is to accelerate what TRAX has started rather than to introduce the idea.
